android.desc:
Pixmap is a resource-light and stable collaborative pixel-art drawing app. Images along with every pixel changed are saved forever with the ability to rewind to any point.

Create and edit pixel art in real time collaboratively. Play with friends or join public servers with thousands editing the same canvas.

NEW - Rewind any Pixmap from start to finish. Take a snapshot or rewind to combat griefers.

NEW - Compete against other players in real time in drawing competitions.
Increase your rank by being the most accurate artist and climb the leader board.

- No brushes, lines, or shapes. Have full control by changing single pixels at a time on the smallest or largest images. *
- Create texture packs, sprites, play with friends, or draw pixel-by-pixel similar to MS Paint
- Create and save your own color palettes.
- Create color palettes based on existing content in public servers! Just pan and zoom to create your palette and then join the fun. 
- Create your own public pixmaps and let the world join.
- Easy to use interface.


* Pixmap supports creating pixmaps 3x3 to 1000x1000 pixels.
